source.title: Algebraic characterization of Ifa main divination codes
source.author: A. Olagunju, A. James, E. Adeyefa, F. Joseph
source.notes: Gold open access under CC BY-NC-ND. Represents the 16 main Odù as 4x2 matrices over {0,1} and shows they form an abelian group under addition mod 2 — the most promising citable source for verifying data/principal_odu.json. NOT YET CONSULTED: the full text sits behind a CAPTCHA and no mirror hosts the PDF, so the bit-pattern table has not been read. Citation verified via Semantic Scholar and OpenAlex 2026-07-28; rights recorded as all-rights-reserved because NC-ND forbids the derivative use republishing would be.
